scope: Pinned engine source and versioned official renderer documentation retrieved after GitHub MCP reading; capability/source interpretation only, not runtime/raster/performance approval

findings.finding: Ambient color*ambient energy is mixed with sky cube*background energy using sky contribution; contribution1 replaces the ambient-color term.
GL Compatibility implements SSAO/glow postprocessing; SSAO intensity/radius are scaled in this implementation.
LINEAR/REINHARD/FILMIC/ACES/AGX tone mapper variants exist in pinned4.7.2 GLES3.
Directional shadow default4 cascades;2 cascade enum and sky light-only enum registered.
Some glow parameters and most advanced SSAO parameters hidden in Compatibility; basic SSAO enabled/radius/intensity exposed.

not_assumed: No SSAO/glow enabled by lighting candidate without separate performance/quality review
Quality0/1 index is actual HUD0balanced/1performance; no inversion bug

additional_read_ranges.finding: Background multiplier is packed into ambient alpha, explicit ambient color*ambient energy into RGB; shader blends these using sky contribution. This is a source interpretation, not observed candidate pixels.
Environment tone mapper is read into the UBO; APPLY_TONEMAPPING is enabled on the non-postprocessing path.
The enabled path calls apply_tonemapping before linear_to_srgb; tonemap_inc.glsl dispatches AGX to tonemap_agx. This is not proof of adopted candidate pixels or performance.
